name: claude-code-prod-starter
description: Production-grade Claude Code starter for engineering teams adopting Opus 4.7. Six PM-style persona agents under a 9-gate governance flow, three reusable specialist agents (code-reviewer, security-auditor, test-engineer), a full SDLC skill library (TDD, debugging, verification, code review, context management, model selection, Karpathy guidelines), seven lifecycle commands (/autopilot, /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /ship), session-start hook with meta-skill auto-injection, and a 5-doc onboarding path. Project-agnostic — fill in PROJECT_CONTEXT.md per repo.
